# `/campaign-templates` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /campaign-templates/v1

`createCampaignTemplateV1` — Create a campaign template

Use this API to create a certification campaign template based on campaign.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-template:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): campaigntemplate
- Returns 200: campaigntemplate

### GET /campaign-templates/v1

`getCampaignTemplatesV1` — List campaign templates

Use this API to get a list of all campaign templates. Scope can be reduced through standard V3 query params. The API returns all campaign templates matching the query parameters.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-template:manage, idn:campaign-template:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name, created, modified — e.g. `name`
  - `filters` (query) — fields: name: eq, ge, gt, in, le, lt, ne, sw; id: eq, ge, gt, in, le, lt, ne, sw — e.g. `name eq "manager template"`
- Returns 200: array of campaigntemplate

### PATCH /campaign-templates/v1/{id}

`patchCampaignTemplateV1` — Update a campaign template

Use this API to update individual fields on a certification campaign template, using the [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) standard.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-template:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign template being modified.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: campaigntemplate

### GET /campaign-templates/v1/{id}

`getCampaignTemplateV1` — Get a campaign template

Use this API to fetch a certification campaign template by ID.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-template:manage, idn:campaign-template:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Requested campaign template's ID.
- Returns 200: campaigntemplate

### DELETE /campaign-templates/v1/{id}

`deleteCampaignTemplateV1` — Delete a campaign template

Use this API to delete a certification campaign template by ID.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-template:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign template being deleted.
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /campaign-templates/v1/{id}/schedule

`getCampaignTemplateScheduleV1` — Get campaign template schedule

Use this API to get the schedule for a certification campaign template. The API returns a 404 if there is no schedule set.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-template:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign template whose schedule is being fetched.
- Returns 200: schedule-2

### PUT /campaign-templates/v1/{id}/schedule

`setCampaignTemplateScheduleV1` — Set campaign template schedule

Use this API to set the schedule for a certification campaign template. If a schedule already exists, the API overwrites it with the new one.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-template:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign template being scheduled.
- Body (application/json): schedule-2
- Returns 204: no body

### DELETE /campaign-templates/v1/{id}/schedule

`deleteCampaignTemplateScheduleV1` — Delete campaign template schedule

Use this API to delete the schedule for a certification campaign template. The API returns a 404 if there is no schedule set.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-template:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign template whose schedule is being deleted.
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /campaign-templates/v1/{id}/generate

`startGenerateCampaignTemplateV1` — Generate a campaign from template

Use this API to generate a new certification campaign from a campaign template. When the template campaign references a campaign filter (`filter.type: CAMPAIGN_FILTER`), the token must include both `idn:campaign-template:manage` and `idn:campaign-filter:read`. The campaign object contained in the template has special formatting applied to its name and description fields that determine the generated campaign's name/description. Placeholders in those fields are formatted with the current date…

- Scopes: idn:campaign-filter:read, idn:campaign-template:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign template to use for generation.
- Returns 200: campaignreference
